SJ19-02.name: Chaotic-Chimeragan
SJ19-02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3][LV4] (Start of Your Attack Step)
By revealing one Cost 7 or more Red-only/Green-only "Ancient Dragon"/"Astral Dragon"/"Galaxian"/"Dragon Warrior"/"War Dragon"/"God-King" family Spirit card from your Hand and putting it on your field, draw a card.

[Unleash: 2] [LV1][LV2][LV3][LV4] (Start of Your Attack Step)
Target a Spirit card that is being put on your Field. During this turn, this Spirit gains all the symbols and the effects of the targeted card. By sending two cores from any of your Grandwalker Nexuses to this Spirit, instead, target two cards.

SJ19-03.name: Grandwalker Chaos
SJ19-03.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Cost 3 or more) (Core Charge via Summon/Advent only once per turn)]
◆When you Summon/Advent a target Spirit, you can put one core from the Void onto this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, put one core from the Void onto this Nexus.

[Grand Field] [LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
Once per turn, by revealing one Cost 7 or more Red-only/Green-only "Ancient Dragon"/"Astral Dragon"/"Galaxian"/"Dragon Warrior"/"War Dragon"/"God-King" family Spirit card from your Hand and putting it on your Field, put one core from the Void to your Reserve.

[Grand Field] [LV2]
When your Cost 7 or more "Galaxian"/"God-King" family Spirit is summoned, send two cores from one opposing Spirit to their Trash.

SJ19-07.name: The BlueZodiacKnight Zodiac-Apollodragon
SJ19-07.effect:
This card's reduction symbols are also treated as Red/Purple/Green/White/Yellow.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can summon a Blue Brave card from your Hand, without paying the cost. When you've done so, during this turn, all your Spirits are treated as being one level higher.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
When this Spirit destroys any opposing Spirit/Ultimate, refresh this Spirit.

SJ19-08.name: The GreenZodiacKnight Zodiac-Apollodragon
SJ19-08.effect:
This card's reduction symbols are also treated as Red/Purple/White/Yellow/Blue.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can summon a Green Brave card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, this Spirit refreshes. Also, while braved to a Brave, return two opposing exhausted Spirits/Ultimates to the deckbottom, in any order.

SJ19-05.name: The RedZodiacKnight Zodiac-Apollodragon
SJ19-05.effect:
This card's reduction symbols are also treated as Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can summon a Red Brave card from your Hand, without paying the cost. The opposing Burst can't activate via this effect.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit gains +10000 BP, and can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. Also, while braved to a Brave, the opponent can't use White Magic cards/[Accel].

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12438.name: The ShiftingSacredSword Cavalshift Order
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12438.effect:
[Brave Condition: Cost 5 or more]

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
█ When this Spirit originally was Red-only, at the end of a blocked battle, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
█ When this Spirit originally was Purple-only, send two cores from one opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve.
█ When this Spirit originally was Green-only, exhaust two opposing Spirits/Ultimates.
█ When this Spirit originally was White-only, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.
█ When this Spirit originally was Yellow-only, during Flash Timing, you can use a Cost 5 or less Magic card from your hand, without paying the cost.
█ When this Spirit originally was Blue-only, destroy an opposing Cost 6 or less Spirit/Ultimate.

SJ19-06.name: The WhiteZodiacKnight Zodiac-Apollodragon
SJ19-06.effect:
This card's reduction symbols are also treated as Red/Purple/Green/Yellow/Blue.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can summon a White Brave card from your Hand, without paying the Cost. The opposing Burst can't activate via this effect.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Heavy Armor: Purple/Yellow/Blue]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/Yellow/Blue Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

[During Brave] [LV2][LV3]
This Spirit gains [Heavy Armor: Red/White].
